region.label: Box
region.hint: Drag a rectangle over the area to change

lasso.label: Lasso
lasso.hint: Draw a loop to select an irregular area

brush.label: Brush
brush.hint: Paint over an area; release to make it a region

pen.label: Sketch
pen.hint: Free-hand hints for the AI; not a selection

border.label: Frame
border.hint: Draw a rectangle or ellipse to highlight a spot

eraser.label: Eraser
eraser.hint: Erase sketch strokes; regions stay intact

toolbar.submit_empty: Select an area to change first

region.badge_hint: Drag to move, click to write a note
region.badge_label: Region {{index}}: drag to move, click to edit

chip.title: Click to describe this region
chip.empty_label: Region {{index}}: no note yet, click to add

bubble.label: Edit note for region {{index}}
bubble.title: Region {{index}}
bubble.placeholder: Describe the change, e.g. make the sky blue…
bubble.keys: Enter to confirm · Shift+Enter newline · Esc to cancel
bubble.go_create_hint: Hand this region and note to the agent for a fuller creation

frame.title: Mark the area
frame.desc: Use Box, Lasso or Brush. Drag the number to move, drag corners to resize

describe.title: Say how to change it
describe.desc: Write in the bubble next to the region. Enter confirms, Esc cancels

submit.title: Send to the AI
submit.desc: Hit “Apply edits” to run all changes at once; ⌘Z undoes anytime
